title: Hiring!
fullText:
HIRING! Male & female creators for paid telehealth video ads —, scripts provided

Hey! I’m with [risenmd.com](http://risenmd.com/) (RisenMD), a telehealth brand connecting patients with licensed providers for medically supervised weight management and Hormone care.

We’re hiring:

* Men ages 30–55 for TRT content.
* Women ages 28–60 and men ages 40–55 for GLP-1 weight-management content.

Each creator will record 5 short, natural, selfie-style videos. Scripts provided, raw vertical footage only, we handle editing. No posting to your account or following required, unless applicable. These are paid presenter roles; personal treatment experience isn’t required.

DM your portfolio, turnaround time, and rates for 5 versus 10 videos, including six months of paid Facebook/Instagram usage and permission to edit.

title: Paying creators to post about job hunting on Instagram/TikTok. No big following needed, performance-based pay
fullText:
Alex here, founder of Quoll Jobs, a job alert site for roles that aren't on the big job sites (mostly Australia, New Zealand and fully remote). Full disclosure up front: this is my company and I'm recruiting for it.  
We're looking for people who can make short videos about job hunting for Instagram or TikTok. Deadpan job-search humour, talking-head tips, "companies hiring right now" roundups, reactions, whatever you're already good at. You don't need a big following and you don't need a job-search background. Use your existing account or start a new one. If it's new, there's a two-day warm-up routine before you post.  
How it works:  
Apply at quolljobs.com/creators/apply  
If approved, you sign in to a creator portal with an emailed link, no password  
The portal has posting guides, video styles and examples  
Post your video, then submit the link in the portal  
Seven days later you submit your view count with a screen recording of your analytics  
Once verified, we pay by bank transfer or PayPal

title: Hi creators 👋 We're BeSpoke AI Stylist, an AI outfit planning and digital wardrobe app on iOS and Android.
fullText:
We'll pay ₹500 (about US$6) for an Instagram or TikTok post or video featuring our Fit Check feature.



How it works:

1. Do a Fit Check in the BeSpoke AI Stylist app

2. Post it on your Instagram or TikTok

3. Tag us (@bespokeaistylist) and use #BeSpokeAIStylist

4. Label it as paid: use the "Paid partnership" label on Instagram or "Content disclosure" on TikTok, and add #ad

5. DM u/bespokeaistylist on Instagram with your post link and your UPI ID (India) or PayPal email (outside India)

6. We pay 7 days after your post went live, once we check it's still up



Requirements:

\- 18+

\- Public account with at least 1,000 real followers

\- The post stays up for at least 30 days

\- One paid post per creator

\- Payment for the first \[100\] eligible posts



We may decline accounts that look like they have bought followers or very low engagement, or posts that don't show a real Fit Check.

title: Skincare Creators: $600/Month + Bonuses 💄
fullText:

title: ToInbox Canvas UGC Collaboration - $400/mo + view bonuses
fullText:
Hey everyone!

I'm looking to collaborate with US-based creators who have actively used LinkedIn to find jobs and enjoy creating content around job hunting, career tips, and the hiring process.

The collaboration is for [**Toinbox.app**](http://Toinbox.app), a job outreach tool that helps job seekers reach relevant hiring contacts through personalized emails.

**What's included:**

* Create one short video per day
* Cross-post on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
* Create dedicated social accounts for the project
* **$400/month fixed retainer**
* Additional bonuses based on video views:
   * 5K views — $10
   * 10K views — $20
   * 20K views — $30
   * 50K views — $100

I'll provide the product, content ideas, hooks, scripts and reference videos. You'll have creative freedom to present everything in your own style.

**Who we're looking for:**

* Based in the US and a native English speaker
* Has actively used LinkedIn to search for jobs
* Comfortable speaking on camera
* Interested in career and job-search content
* Previous UGC experience is a plus

We're looking for someone reliable who wants to build engaging job hunt content consistently.

Interested? Drop your portfolio or a link to your videos in the comments or dm!
